## File: facebookresearch_projectariatools/examples/Gen1/python_samples/automated_speech_recognition/speech_recognition_demo.py

Prompts

```
['run automated speech recognition on a VRS file using faster-whisper to transcribe audio into text segments', 'extract audio from a VRS file as a WAV file using the extract_audio function', 'transcribe audio with per-word timestamps using faster-whisper and the WhisperModel transcribe API', 'align speech recognition timestamps to the Aria VRS time domain using the data provider', 'export transcribed word segments with timestamps and confidence scores to a CSV file']
```

Usage

```
{'run_speech_recognition_from_vrs': 'run automated speech recognition on a VRS file using faster-whisper to transcribe audio into text segments', 'extract_audio_from_vrs': 'extract audio from a VRS file as a WAV file using the extract_audio function', 'transcribe_audio_with_word_timestamps': 'transcribe audio with per-word timestamps using faster-whisper and the WhisperModel transcribe API', 'align_timestamps_to_aria_domain': 'align speech recognition timestamps to the Aria VRS time domain using the data provider', 'export_transcription_to_csv': 'export transcribed word segments with timestamps and confidence scores to a CSV file'}
```
